title: "What We Can't Measure, We Can't Understand": Challenges to Demographic Data Procurement in the Pursuit of Fairness
benchmark_measurement: The paper is a qualitative study based on interviews with practitioners and does not conduct any benchmark measurements. It focuses on the challenges of procuring demographic data for fairness assessments in general, without specifically measuring aspects of faith or religion.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a focus of the study. The research centers on the practical, legal, and organizational challenges of using demographic data like race, gender, and age for algorithmic fairness.
